title: Coin Melt Value vs Catalog Value Spread
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=coin:item
| search catalog_value=* melt_value=*
| stats avg(catalog_value-melt_value) as avg_value_gap max(catalog_value-melt_value) as max_value_gap by metal_type
| sort 0 - avg_value_gap
description: Ranks metal typess by melt versus catalog spread.
value: The spread helps show whether a category is being held for bullion logic or for numismatic interest.
implementation: Send melt versus catalog spread events to `index=personal` and keep `metal_type` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of melt versus catalog spread by metal types.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which metal typess stand out most for melt versus catalog spread.
